name: Franklin Farms
old_description: We are equal parts wisdom and energy. With inspirations both classic and modern. We help you achieve balance as well as fun. Here's to your good health and great taste.
about:
Franklin Farms traces its roots to 1981, when it started on a mushroom farm in Franklin, Connecticut. The company is now headquartered in Boulder, Colorado. No founders are named in the source material, and ownership structure is not disclosed.

The company manufactures a wide range of plant-based proteins, including veggie burgers, breakfast items, veggie balls, seitan, tofu (organic super firm, organic, ready-bake kits), plant-powered meat, seasoned seitan, edamame, tempeh, fusion tofu, chickpea tofu and tempeh, and plant-based tuna. Production processes involve mixing, splicing, mingling, and dicing flavor-forward, high-quality plant proteins, with an explicit commitment to avoiding genetic engineering. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

Franklin Farms serves retail grocery and foodservice channels, targeting consumers seeking meatless meals that span day parts and taste profiles. Its products appear in natural and conventional grocery aisles, though specific customer names are not provided. The company positions itself in the plant-based food manufacturing, vegetarian and vegan foods, and retail food product sectors.

The brand emphasizes bringing "the best food from field to table," blending classic and modern inspirations to make plant-based cooking easy and delicious. Its stated differentiation rests on non-GMO ingredient sourcing, flavor-forward formulations, and a product portfolio designed for both quick bites and sit-down dinners.
